enemy.name: Kaleidoqueen
enemy.flavour_text: The queen of the pincerbugs, protected by giant pincerbugs, and reigning over the smaller pincerbugs. Her pheromone commands other pincerbugs to her will. There is typically only one queen in a colony, as the previous queen will devolve when a new queen emerges. The reason why people call her 'Kaleidoqueen' will become apparent if you anger her.

abilities.text: Deals heavy Physical damage to surrounding allied units when all <Pincerbugs> are defeated
Physical and Arts damage taken is reduced by a certain percentage for each <Giant Pincerbug> on the field
Summons 2 <Giant Pincerbugs> and slowly recovers HP when defeated for the first time, then switches to 2nd form after some time
Becomes Aerial, Attack Interval greatly reduced, Movement Speed increased, and ATK greatly increased
Greatly increases the Max HP of other Infected Creatures on the field
